description: This Java source file defines the OpenmrsObjectSaveHandler class, which is a handler responsible for processing objects that implement the OpenmrsObject interface during save operations in the OpenMRS platform. It ensures that each object has a UUID and manages string properties by trimming whitespace and setting empty strings to null, respecting specific annotations.

classes.name: OpenmrsObjectSaveHandler
classes.description: A handler class that processes OpenmrsObject instances during save operations, setting UUIDs and managing string properties.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Handles the save operation for an OpenmrsObject, setting UUID if null, trimming whitespace, and converting empty strings to null based on annotations.
